cohorts.construction: GenerationConfig(train_rows=N, validation_rows=12, seeds); keep the N train-split rows; discard 12 validation rows; row ids prefixed by role

split_use.CAL_C: per-lift scale multiplier c for B1 and H only
split_use.CAL_G: 36 plan/horizon/lift group multipliers for H only
split_use.FIT: ridge scale head and B1 residual RMS only
split_use.TEST: scored once after every parameter is frozen; no selection

location.ensemble: arithmetic mean of three seed outputs in standardized space, then de-standardized once; weights never refit

methods.B1: per plan/horizon/lift RMS of (y-mu) on FIT, clipped to [0.25,100] kg

H.features: 127 visible summaries + that lift's mu + 12 plan/horizon one-hots = 140
H.ridge: unpenalized intercept; minimize mean squared error + 0.05*||beta||^2
H.standardization: FIT mean and population SD, floor 1e-6
H.visible_summaries: per lift and observed channel (assessment, prescribed load, velocity, observed relative load, assessment delta, velocity delta) first, last, mean, population SD, OLS slope over index 0..31 (90); per lift and schedule channel (dose, intensity, dose x intensity) mean, last-4 mean, last (27); six plan numerics and four plan indicators (10)

methods.calibration_G: g=clip(sqrt((n*R+kappa)/(n+kappa)),0.70,1.40), n=rows in the group (256 in the full profile), kappa=256, R=mean_CAL_G((y-mu)^2/sigma_H^2) per plan/horizon/lift; sigma_HG=clip(g*sigma_H,0.25,100)
methods.no_selection: no hyperparameter search, no model selection, no winner chosen; every constant above is fixed before any scientific call
methods.truncation_T: applied to cessation rows of B1_T, H_T, H_GT; identical to the Gaussian arm for all other plans

nonclaims: does not reproduce historical M11/M12 scores or parameters
no conditional-reliability or distribution-shift claim; M12 shifts are not run
not an independent external scientific review

resources.on_limit: stop; report an honest limitation; no automatic expansion

protocol.route: B: independent public reference implementation; NOT a reproduction of M10-M12

scoring.macro: equal mean of the three per-lift means
scoring.point_forecast: GRU location mu; separate from the truncated predictive mean

protocol.stopping: report the limitation if any resource ceiling is reached; do not retry or expand scope

target.definition: C[origin+h-1]-C[origin-1] in kg; simulated latent capacity, not 1RM
target.truncation_rule: upper-truncate the Gaussian at 0 for plan cessation only; valid because zero dose makes adaptation decay so the latent change is nonpositive; never applied to any other plan or target

order: compute and hash all TEST mu and sigma
open TEST truth and score once
truth_firewall.strength: in-process organizational barrier recorded by receipt hashes; not adversarial isolation
